correctness.rationale: PASS: The LCF sequence (5,7,-7,7,-7,-5)^3 reconstructs the connected bipartite 18-vertex cubic Pappus graph. Faces of Ind₂(P) are exactly vertex masks with induced degree at most 1 (no connected induced triple). Independently enumerating all 2^18 masks agrees with the incremental face construction, giving 20,651 nonempty faces and the published complete f-vector. A freshly reconstructed vertex-toggle matching pairs 10,320 faces and leaves a critical vertex, nine critical 5-faces and one critical 6-face. Every one of 120,222 directed Hasse incidences was included in a complete acyclic topological sort visiting all 20,651 faces. Exact signed integer gradient-path cancellation gives the single critical 6→5 Morse boundary column (0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0), with 933 memoized intermediate projections. The 5-skeleton is wedge^9S^5; Hurewicz π5≅H5 identifies its 6-cell map, and the zero attaching vector makes the extra S^6. Thus the claimed integral homotopy wedge, not merely mod-two Betti numbers, is established for this finite graph.
